newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey still assessing barley tender bids.
newsitem.headline: Turkey still assessing barley tender bids.

text.p: The Turkish Grain Board (TMO) is still assessing bids at a tender to sell 150,000 tonnes of feed barley and 50,000 tonnes of malting barley for shipment in February and March, officials said on Tuesday.
"We have time until five p.m. (1500 GMT) and we will have decided by then," said one TMO official.

Traders said they thought the TMO, which held the public tender on Monday, had found bid prices lower than expected and might award only a 25,000-tonne contract for the highest price, which was $133.06 per tonne and came from Grains & Fourrages.
Cargill, Glencore, Rotel and Sesos were the other bidders.
Per tonne prices for feed barley ranged between $121.46 and $133.06 for various shipment dates and ports.
Only Gelncore bid for the malting barley at "the agreed price for feed barley plus $17."
Traders said Grains & Fourrages planned to sell to Israel.
